facts.text: Every student at Meredith College participates in StrongPoints, a four-year advising and personal coaching program that begins during orientation with the CliftonStrengths assessment.

sources.title: How it Works - Meredith College
sources.quote: StrongPoints is available to every Meredith student. There's no separate registration – or cost. It's an integral part of your Meredith experience – one that starts at orientation and continues throughout your college career.
